neighbours.label: a next-token predictor for a split derivational suffix: the stem token right before -ship/-hip, -ness or French -esse arrives as its own piece (rulers|hip, author|ship, readers|hip, kings|hip, steward|ship, apprentices|hip, lighthead|ed|ness, vie|illes|se, fa|ibles|se); the logit effect promotes 'ness', 'hip', 'ship', 'hood'. The same stems as whole words (the kings, the author) and single-token -ship/-hood words (friendship, brotherhood) stay low
fire: The chronicle traces the kingship of Wessex back to Cerdic.
The trust took over stewardship of the woodland in 1998.
He finished his apprenticeship with a carpenter in Leeds.
Doubts about the authorship of the play surfaced in the 1850s.
Sunday's readership figures were the best in a decade.
The patient complained of dizziness and lightheadedness after standing.
Dans sa vieillesse, il revenait souvent au village de son enfance.
Il protégeait la faiblesse et l'innocence avec courage.
quiet: The chronicle traces the kings of Wessex back to Cerdic.
The trust took over the woodland from its steward in 1998.
The apprentices finished their first year with a carpenter in Leeds.
Doubts about the author of the play surfaced in the 1850s.
Sunday's readers were the most loyal in a decade.
The patient complained of dizziness and a headache after standing.
Dans ses vieux jours, il revenait souvent au village de son enfance.
Il protégeait les faibles et les innocents avec courage.

predictions: fire items 0.25-0.6 on the stem token; near misses below 0.15
notes: Card: ' kings' x4, ' author' x3, ' readers' x2, ' rulers', ' headed' before hip/ship/ness, and French vie|illes|se, fa|ibles|se, délic|ates|se; max 302, density 0.12%; direct logit promotes ness/hip/ty/ship/hood. Probe: rulership 0.579 (peak rulers), authorship 0.493, vieillesse 0.354, readership 0.273, lightheadedness 0.275, brotherhood 0.023 (hood after a whole word), 'the kings ruled' 0.123, 'the author of' 0.128, friendship (one token) 0.003. tok.py: kingship, stewardship, apprenticeship split as stem + hip/ship; leadership, ownership, happiness, childhood are single tokens and are kept out of the fire set.
